A '''Garna tree''' was a species of tree that was native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pamorjal]].

==History==
During the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the wood from Garna trees became popular in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], so mega-corporations, such as [[Tagge Company/Legends|TaggeCo]], began harvesting them from Pamorjal. However, some of the citizens of Pamorjal opposed this exploitation of the planet, so they formed a resistance movement called the [[Pamorjal Freeman's League]]. The League attacked the assets on Pamorjal of all mega-corporations that were harvesting the trees.
